name: asteria-investment-office-json
description: Produce committee-grade JSON answers for the Asteria Investment Office across five portfolio archetypes — (a) energy-credit trade packages, (b) international equity correlation reviews, (c) active allocation-view refreshes, (d) fixed-income risk rebalances, and (e) multi-asset committee decisions. Covers the exact endpoints to pull, the deterministic computation recipes (Pearson correlation on monthly simple returns, notional-weighted modified duration and YTM, HY allocation %, carry, concentration), the policy thresholds that drive views/conviction/constraint checks, and the output-schema conventions (field names, enum sets, rounding, id ordering) that the desk's answer templates require. Use whenever a task references an Asteria portfolio (PF-*), index (IDX_*), bond (BND_*), issuer (ISS_*), policy (POL_*), or an answer_template.json.
